answer: Sybil resistance here is a pricing problem, not an identity one. The intake draw hashes each address against the epoch number, so one lucky identity cannot be reused across seats: a farmer must field a separate vault per wallet, each funded, each attesting real work before anything pays. Cloning a key is free; cloning a balance is not. An island of fresh addresses parked in the canyon of the queue, never attested, earns nothing while the cost of running it keeps climbing.
